cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a Han-era workshop beside a smithy — adjusts a small mechanism on the work surface with a small screwdriver; a Korean jjimjilbang hall with heated floors and sleeping mats — dries her hair with a towel; the open deck of a wooden sightseeing boat on the Yangtze — standing; the back seat of a taxi at night — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; a club powder room with a lit mirror and neon on the tiles — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — standing; a narrow path through a tall bamboo grove — standing; a candlelit gala dinner hall — holds a cup in both hands; the long stone stairway of Baidicheng above the Yangtze gorge — pours from a gourd-shaped wine flask on a red cord into a small cup on the table; inside a knightly order's campaign pavilion — holds a bowl of hot food at chest height; a convention photo zone under ring lights — holds a masquerade mask on a stick up to her eyes; an ice palace hall of carved crystal pillars — holds her keepsake at chest height; a desert oasis at golden hour — lying on her front
